en: This black-and-white postcard shows a historical scene inside a medical facility, specifically an inoculation hall. Several men, some in white coats and others in civilian clothing, are gathered around a seated patient receiving an injection. The room has checkered flooring, barred partitions, and a uniformed official observing or recording the event. The setting appears early 20th century, and the environment looks formal and clinical.
